modmenu.descriptionTranslation.caketext-: Shared code for CakeText Collector and CakeText Translator.
caketext.exchange.done: Converted %s files into %s files in exchange/converted (click to open).
caketext.exchange.empty: Nothing to convert. Put .json, .json.gz, .po or .pot files into %s and run this again (click to open).
caketext.exchange.tip: Converts every file in config/caketext/exchange: our .json/.json.gz into Crowdin .po/.pot files, and .po/.pot back into .json. Results go to exchange/converted.
caketext.ignored_items.tip: Item ids whose tooltips are never translated (they are still collected). Default: *sign (all signs and hanging signs), *book (all books), *shulker_box (all shulker boxes). Without a namespace a pattern matches any mod's items.
